read_by: Agent-drafted, from the binding README, binding.json and the source cell's tier table
input: FSim fire intensity class at the station reference point, exact integer 1 to 6 (0 = no event); no interpolation or heat-flux conversion
not_covered: Rest of the fenced station ($14,327,879.37, 52.38%): bus supports, dead-ends, oil containment and firewall, relay panels, control house, station battery, SCADA, station service, control cable, conduit and trench, site work, drainage and lightning shielding
out_of_scope: External access road and project support allowances ($3.06M, outside the fenced value)
Business interruption, revenue and insurance terms

how_to_use.share_of: Bound electrical equipment value of the station, $13,025,357 (eight equipment rows); % of TIV divides by the full fenced value $27,353,236.37

outputs.single_event: conditional: equipment damage ratio for an exact FSim class at the facility point
outputs.scenario_dollars: conditional: damage ratio times $13,025,357; remaining fenced value withheld
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: Hazard computes it after frequency, class, value, cap and spatial-aggregation proof; capped at $13,025,357

conditions: Pin the source artifact (wildfire_solar v1.0 docs r3) and this binding by hash
Burn probability and class probability stay separate, in Hazard
No extra contact, perimeter, gravel, firebreak, firewall or enclosure credit
Apply the one response once to the declared assembly; no child losses on top
Withheld station value is a response gap, not immunity

method.summary: The canonical solar wildfire transformer/switchgear (MV equipment) response is reused once for the station's transformer and switchgear equipment as a T4 assembly transfer (see docs/contracts/hazard_handoff/substation_wildfire_screening_v1/README.md)

key_sources: Canonical wildfire_solar model v1.0 docs r3, WSV1_MV_EQUIPMENT_THERMAL (ordinate table and value linkage)
USFS FSim RDS-2016-0034-3 (native fire class and burn probability)
Hazard substation profile (asset_model.json): 345/138 kV AIS, two 336 MVA transformers
MISO MTEP24 published cost tables (equipment value rows)
judgment: Source class ordinates are engineering judgment, not measured failure rates
Instrument and protection equipment counted inside the modeled electrical assembly
open_items: 52.38% of fenced station value has no wildfire response
Tank and oil versus breaker or instrument behaviour not resolved; replace when a station-specific electrical model is qualified

rows.shape_basis: Source class ordinates are T4; the MV-to-HV transfer is also T4
rows.cost_basis: Source damage ratio is already a share of value (T4); equipment row membership is T4

notes.text: FSim class is landscape severity, not local heat at the equipment
